svg.title: ATSker tech stack
svg.desc: Application: Python, FastAPI, HTMX, Jinja, Tailwind CSS, Pydantic, pdfplumber. AI: OpenRouter, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Haiku 5.5. Data: PostgreSQL, Neon, SQLAlchemy, Alembic. Cloud and delivery: Cloud Run, Secret Manager, Docker, GitHub Actions. Quality: pytest, Ruff, uv.
